summary: OpenAI published a data report ('OpenAI Signals') showing how ChatGPT usage has grown and diversified over time, including higher per-user message volume, broader regional and demographic adoption, and expanding non-English usage.

mechanisms.reason: The document reports quantified growth in per-user messaging frequency and in weekly active users across regions, both indicating rising aggregate ChatGPT usage volume.
mechanisms.quote: Six months after signing up, users sent 50% more messages per day than they did when they signed up.
